description: This file defines the ControlChannel class responsible for managing a control communication channel, including connection states, request handling, event stream processing, and error management within an OpenClaw project. It also includes several related data structures, error enums, and extensions for handling control-related events and state updates.

classes.name: ControlChannel
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle, state, and communication over a control channel, including configuration, health checks, event handling, and recovery mechanisms.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Initial configuration of the control channel, setting it to local mode and refreshing the endpoint.

methods.name: configure(mode:)
methods.description: Configures control channel mode as either local or remote with target and identity, establishing necessary connections.

methods.name: refreshEndpoint
methods.description: Attempts to establish or refresh the control connection endpoint based on the reason provided.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Shuts down the current control connection and resets state variables.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a health check request to the control server, returning Data or throwing an error.

methods.name: lastHeartbeat
methods.description: Fetches the last heartbeat event received from the control server.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Executes a control request with specified method, params, and timeout, returning the response data.

methods.name: friendlyGatewayMessage
methods.description: Converts internal errors into user-facing, actionable error messages.

methods.name: scheduleRecovery
methods.description: Schedules a recovery attempt after a brief delay, managing backoff and mode-specific recovery actions.

methods.name: establishGatewayConnection
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the gateway and verifies its health.

methods.name: refreshAuthSourceLabel
methods.description: Updates the label indicating the current authentication source.

methods.name: sendSystemEvent
methods.description: Sends a system event message to the control server with optional parameters.

methods.name: startEventStream
methods.description: Initializes the subscription to receive push events from the gateway.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push events, processing different event types like agent, heartbeat, shutdown, etc.

methods.name: routeWorkActivity
methods.description: Routes activity data from control agent events to appropriate handlers.
